rationale: All artifact uses across the whitepaper, outline, integration notes, research findings, figures, and video script accurately preserve the claim's scope and boundary. The UK CAA's CAP3127 statements regarding DAA risk-ratio averaging limits, encounter-set dependencies, and the insufficiency of aggregate metrics are consistently framed as consultation/test-phase DAA metric context and used to justify disaggregating risk evidence rather than asserted as an established universal AI certification standard or approved design standard.
limitations: CAP3127 reflects a UK consultation response summary on a policy concept and progressive test phase; project-specific UK acceptance criteria require inspection of current CAP3015 and published AMC/GM.
